title: Saturn Super Henshuubu Hen: Taikenban Saturn Soft Taizen
native_title: サターンスーパー編集部 編 体験版サターンソフト大全
overview: A collection of trial versions of Saturn software compiled by the editors of Saturn Super magazine, released with a special issue of the magazine and published by Captain Soft. As the title suggests, it gathers playable trial editions of Saturn games on one disc.
